newsitem.title: POLAND: INVESTORS BID TO BUY PLN 580 MLN OF POLISH T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: INVESTORS BID TO BUY PLN 580 MLN OF POLISH T-BILLS.

text.p: Investors bid to buy a total of 580 million zlotys worth of Polish T-bills at Monday's 1.2 billion zloty tender, the National Bank of Poland said.

It said demand for the 13-week paper was 202.4 million zlotys against a 200 million offer, for the 26-week bills 111.5 million zlotys against a 300 million offer and for the 52-week paper 266.4 million against a 700 million zloty offer.
Full details of the auction should be available later today.
